commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' 42:58 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
90+4' Leif Davis (Ipswich) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
90+4' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Ipswich.
90+1' Graham Potter prepares a substitution. Jean-Clair Todibo is replaced by Aaron Cresswell (West Ham).
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Leif Davis (Ipswich) swings in a cross from the corner, but Lukasz Fabianski reads it well and gathers the ball.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Massimo Luongo (Ipswich) will replace Samy Morsy.
87' 1 - 3 Goal - 1:3! Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) tries his luck from the edge of the box and scores with an accurate shot inside the left post. Guido Rodriguez provided an assist for the goal.
85' 4:5 – this is the current number of shots on target.
81' The foul by Liam Delap (Ipswich) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Tim Robinson.
80' Today's match ends for Edson Alvarez who will be replaced by Lucas Paqueta (West Ham).
80' Graham Potter decides to make a substitution. James Ward-Prowse will be replaced by Guido Rodriguez (West Ham).
78' Substitution. Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) has come on for Nathan Broadhead.
78' Here is a change. Jens Cajuste is going off and Kieran McKenna gives the last tactical orders to Jack Taylor (Ipswich).
75' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich).
73' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Niclas Fullkrug walks off the pitch to be replaced by Mohammed Kudus (West Ham).
72' Here comes a substitution. Oliver Scarles is given a rest as he is replaced by Vladimir Coufal (West Ham).
70' Kieran McKenna has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jack Clarke (Ipswich) replacing Conor Chaplin.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Liam Delap (Ipswich) comes onto the pitch so that George Hirst can be given a rest.
67' Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
66' The corner is swung in but Ipswich can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
65' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Ipswich have been awarded a corner kick.
64' The game is interrupted now, Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
63' Leif Davis (Ipswich) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
63' Leif Davis (Ipswich) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
61' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) sends a cross into the box, but Alex Palmer comes off his line to gather the ball.
60' Nathan Broadhead (Ipswich) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
59' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham).

55' 1 - 2 Goal! Aaron Wan-Bissaka sets up Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) for a shot on the edge of the box. He doesn't hit the cleanest of shots, but the ball somehow finds its way into the right side of the goal. 1:2.
52' 1 - 1 Goal! Jens Cajuste plays a long ball to Nathan Broadhead (Ipswich), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the left of the goal. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 1:1.

52' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Alex Palmer pulls off an easy save.
50' Oliver Scarles (West Ham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alex Palmer, who smothers the ball.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' 0 - 1 Goal! Jarrod Bowen provides James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort inside the right post. 0:1.
42' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) is flagged for offside.
40' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the roof of the net, but Alex Palmer is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
39' Oliver Scarles (West Ham) passes the ball and slows down the tempo so his team can continue with their combination play.
35' Tim Robinson shows the yellow card to Max Kilman (West Ham) for a heavy challenge.
35' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
34' The ball possession at the moment is 40:60.
30' CHANCE! Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a low shot towards Alex Palmer, who produces an excellent reflex save.

27' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) makes a yard for himself and attempts to endanger the goalkeeper with a long-range shot. His great effort, however, goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.

26' Nathan Broadhead (Ipswich) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Lukasz Fabianski makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the right side of the goal.
25' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
24' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
24' Jacob Greaves (Ipswich) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
22' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lukasz Fabianski intercepts the ball.
21' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
19' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
18' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
16' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
13' Max Kilman (West Ham) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.

11' Jacob Greaves (Ipswich) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header, but it goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
11' Leif Davis (Ipswich) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
10' George Hirst (Ipswich) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
8' The West Ham players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
7' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.

5' Nice move, nice attempt! Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
4' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
3' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
